_comment: Combat tuning. Every number here is a first guess, not balance. Energy values are in whole points unless the key ends in _milli (thousandths of a point). A skill with "effect": "heal" restores (attack x power_percent / 100) hp to a living ally, capped at what it lost; "guard" blocks power_percent of the target's next hit; every other skill deals damage.
_player_skills_comment: Skills of a squad member whose summary lists no skills (old saves, tools, tests). Drafted bots fight with their own skills through bot_skill_effects instead.
_basic_attack_comment: Every squad member keeps this skill, so it always has something to do: it is added when none of the bot's own skills is a free single-target attack. The strike-cost switch (data/variants/variants.json) may give it a cost and its own recharge; a unit that cannot afford it waits.
_bot_skill_effects_comment: Bot skill effect_id (data/bot_data/skills.json) -> the combat skill it fights with. The bot's name and level for the skill carry over; cost, power, effect and target come from skills below.
_skills_comment: effect: damage (default), heal or guard. target: opponent (default for damage), all_opponents, ally (default for heal and guard; the user included) or self. For a guard, power_percent is the share of the target's next hit it blocks.
